props.gloss_en: Rav (version 1): but wine does not require reclining
Rav (version 2): [the mishnah] taught this only of bread
bread, for which reclining is effective
Rav (version 2): but for wine reclining is not effective
R' Yochanan (version 2): even for wine reclining is effective
the baraita: [while seated] water is brought and each washes one hand; when they have gone up and reclined and water comes, though each washed one hand, he washes both hands again
the baraita: guests enter and sit on benches and chairs until all have entered; wine came to them -- each one blesses for himself
the baraita: they went up and reclined; wine came to them -- though each already blessed for himself, one blesses for all
guests are different, for their mind is on moving on
there it is different: since reclining is effective for the bread, it is effective for the wine
